# [TASK] Local observability stack: kube-prometheus-stack + docker-compose ELK

## Task
Stand up the full local observability stack per ARCHITECTURE.md §12: kube-prometheus-stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager) plus a docker-compose ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Filebeat).

## Parent Story
Parent: #87

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.elk.yml` + a Logstash pipeline parse services' JSON logs into `filmpire-logs-%{+yyyy.MM.dd}`, with a 7-day ILM delete policy
- [x] kube-prometheus-stack Helm values + a ServiceMonitor per service (`infrastructure/kubernetes/monitoring/`), targeting the `monitoring: enabled` label #25's Service manifests carry
- [x] Grafana dashboards as ConfigMaps (JVM, HTTP, gateway, infrastructure) and alert rules (service down >2min, P95>500ms, heap>85%, restart loops)
- [x] Kibana shows parsed logs with the `application` field — verified live: 45,000+ documents indexed, ILM policy + index template confirmed via the ES API
- [x] Grafana shows live JVM + HTTP metrics, and Alertmanager fires on a killed service — both verified live (queried real PromQL through Grafana's own datasource proxy; froze a pod via containerd's cgroup-freezer and watched `FilmpireServiceDown` fire exactly 2 minutes later)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 11

## Notes
Depends on service instrumentation (#23, done).
